en.title: US denies visa: UN General Assembly decision on 'Mahmud Abbas'
en.summary: The UN General Assembly voted to allow Palestinian President Mahmud Abbas to address the assembly via pre-recorded video message after the US denied him a visa. The decision passed with support from 152 countries, while 3 voted against and 4 abstained.

en.title: Security directorate decree published: Police Chief who testified in Gülistan Doku investigation transferred to headquarters
en.summary: A provincial police chiefs decree was published in the Official Gazette. Yalova Police Chief Yılmaz Delen, who testified as a witness in the Gülistan Doku investigation, was transferred to headquarters, while Deputy Police Director General Mahmut Çorumlu was appointed to lead the Police Directorate.
